summary: Ambev S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting Board-approved distributions: (i) the third and final installment of December 2025 interest on capital (IOC) of R$0.1185 gross per share (net R$0.1007), paid October 6, 2026, totaling ~R$1.6bn, and (ii) a new IOC July 2026 of R$0.0713 gross per share (net R$0.0588), totaling ~R$1.1bn, offset against the 2026 mandatory dividend. Record dates are September 21, 2026 (B3) and September 23, 2026 (NYSE); ex-date September 22, 2026. These are routine capital return payments, not a special situation.
